title: smime-tree: encrypt() panics on OS RNG failure for RSA recipients — panic in library code
description: build_rsa_recipient() uses UnwrapErr(SysRng) which panics if the OS RNG fails (rsa::encrypt requires CryptoRng and has no fallible variant). The doc comment documents this as a panic but library callers reasonably expect all error conditions to be surfaced as Result::Err. Scenario: OS RNG temporarily fails (container seccomp policy, /dev/urandom not seeded at boot); the application process is killed by an unexpected panic rather than handling a recoverable error. Maintenance consequence: any user hitting this will file an issue; it is architecturally inconsistent with the ECDH path which correctly returns Err.
